flows.name: Production IDS: Go Nose -> Canonical Event -> Detection -> Forensic Record -> IDS Evidence Receipt
flows.plane: PLANE-A -> PLANE-B -> PLANE-D (conditional PEP) -> PLANE-B evidence
flows.description: Canonical production network IDS path. Host telemetry is evidence-only; host-effect activation is out of scope. Direct Npcap full-payload capture is a separate lab/test path; XDR is advisory recording-only on the production detection path and is documented in XDR-PROD-001.
flows.boundary: Go Nose length-prefixed named pipe -> Zig; conditional Rust PEP ABI; no production host effect

layers.name: Packet Capture
layers.input: Raw network packets from Go Nose capture (Npcap backend on Windows)
layers.note: Go Nose is the canonical production ingress. The separate direct-Npcap full-payload path is lab-only and must use a disjoint interface.

layers.name: Canonical Event
layers.output: CanonicalEvent (109-byte v1 / 133-byte v2; ContextFlags carries TCP flags)
layers.note: RB021: raw TCP flags travel in ContextFlags bits 16..23 with valid bit 24; the wire length/offset is unchanged.

layers.name: Length-Prefixed Named-Pipe Transport
layers.input: CanonicalEvent frame (u32 LE length + 109-byte v1 or 133-byte v2 wire bytes)
layers.boundary: Windows named pipe \\.\pipe\aegis_nose; loopback TCP is a non-Windows development fallback

layers.name: Detection
layers.note: Payload rules use Aho-Corasick; rules with layer=L4 are parsed separately (src/pipeline/l4_matcher.zig) and matched per packet on protocol/TCP flags, not on payload text. Canonical Nose now supplies flags through the ContextFlags lane (RB021 E2); live R9006/R9007 proof is still pending.

layers.name: Policy Observation
layers.output: Policy action (when a network rule matches)
layers.note: Host telemetry and protocol-anomaly-only events may be recorded but do not authorize policy evaluation or host effects.

layers.name: Conditional Rust PEP Guard
layers.output: PEP decision; host-mutating actions escalate while the lab gate is closed
layers.note: The compile-time lab prevention gate defaults false. Production host-effect activation is out of scope.

layers.name: Receipt-Aware Action Dispatch
layers.note: Host effects remain out of scope in production; any lab effect requires a validated provider read-back receipt.

layers.name: Decision Trace and Audit
layers.note: The audit trace is written before forensic append.

layers.name: Forensic Record
layers.input: QueuedEvent + detection + policy/PEP decision + audit identity
layers.output: ForensicRecord in the hash-chained runtime ring

layers.name: IDS Evidence Receipt
layers.input: Detection identity + accepted forensic sequence + authenticated record hash read-back
layers.output: Recording-only IDS Evidence Receipt (no host-effect claim)

layers.name: Optional SIEM Projection
layers.note: Observe-only; not an enforcement or policy authority.

layers.name: Optional Brain Inspection
layers.output: Fire-and-forget UDP JSON inspection offer; no in-band decision response
layers.note: Optional and non-blocking. Any Python finding returns only as a separate opt-in BRAIN-002 advisory sensor event; it does not directly gate policy or host effects.

layers.name: NDJSON Evidence Projection
layers.note: The forensic ring remains the detection record; this projection does not claim host effect.

layers.name: Zig BrainAdvisor
layers.input: Detection, correlation, flow, threat-intel, and RAG context

layers.name: Production Wiring Status

flows.name: Optional Python Brain Inspection -> Advisory Sensor Event
flows.description: When AEGIS_BRAIN=1, Zig offers detected events to Python over UDP. When AEGIS_SENSOR_PIPE=1, Python may return a finding as a new advisory anomaly event through the admin-only sensor pipe. This is not a direct ThreatScore-to-policy command.
flows.boundary: UDP 127.0.0.1:9999 offer; opt-in admin-only named pipe \\.\pipe\aegis_sensor_pipe_t1 return

layers.name: Optional Detection Offer
layers.input: Matched detection identity and event metadata

layers.name: Python Brain Inspection
layers.note: The offer is fire-and-forget; the live pipeline does not wait for a response.

layers.name: Opt-In Finding Return
layers.input: Tier-2 finding with rule, severity, and network metadata
layers.output: JSON payload sent only when AEGIS_SENSOR_PIPE=1
layers.note: A failed or disabled sensor-pipe send is not a detection or enforcement claim.

layers.name: Brain Provenance Event Admission
layers.input: JSON finding from the named pipe
layers.output: IpcEvent(source=detection_brain, kind=anomaly_detected) in daemon event queue
layers.note: The adapter assigns brain provenance and submits an event; it does not issue a policy action.

layers.name: Standard IDS Event Processing
layers.output: Standard detection/recording path; any policy decision remains subject to the production PEP guard
layers.note: No direct score feedback, policy bypass, or host-effect claim is made by the Brain event itself.

flows.name: Standalone XDR multi-source evidence correlation (LAB/test-only)
flows.description: Lab/test-only standalone proof of the advisory XDR evidence bridge: caller-created evidence is correlated, persisted as a versioned forensic snapshot, acknowledged by a recording-only IDS receipt after hash read-back, then reconstructed and replayed. Production imports the same bridge only through recordXdrAdvisoryReceipt; that route is documented in XDR-PROD-001.
flows.boundary: In-process Zig module interface; no FFI or daemon connection

layers.name: Evidence Input
layers.input: Caller-created Evidence with source category, entity key, event id, timestamp, and severity
layers.note: The lab/test bridge also requires a source IpcEvent whose identity is present in the evidence batch.

layers.name: Multi-source Incident Correlation
layers.output: Incident with source-category bitmask and maximum observed severity

layers.name: Advisory Summary
layers.note: A multi-source advisory only; no action, policy decision, PEP dispatch, or host-effect claim exists.

layers.name: Forensic Snapshot and Record
layers.output: Versioned snapshot appended to hash-chained forensic ring
layers.note: The bridge rejects invalid/multi-entity batches and does not invoke PEP.

layers.name: IDS Evidence Receipt
layers.output: Non-enforcement receipt bound to the correlation record
layers.note: Receipt is issued only after append and hash read-back; it proves recording, never a host effect.

layers.name: Integrity Verification and Replay
layers.output: CRC/hash/identity verification and deterministic assessment comparison
layers.note: The integration test also passes the retained record through ReplayVerifier.

layers.name: Production Integration Status
layers.note: This caller-driven proof remains lab-only. Production imports the bridge only through pipeline/event_processor.recordXdrAdvisoryReceipt; no policy/PEP/DEFCON/ActionDispatcher/host-effect consumer exists.

flows.name: Production advisory XDR recording-only source-to-forensic receipt and replay
flows.description: Detection-identity events feed the selected advisory XDR fabric. When a multi-source advisory assessment freezes, the observation batch is appended to the hash-chained forensic ring, an IDS Evidence Receipt is issued after hash read-back, and the assessment can be replayed. The receipt is recording-only: it proves evidence persistence, never a host effect, and no policy/PEP/DEFCON/ActionDispatcher consumer reads it.
flows.boundary: In-process Zig only: event_processor -> xdr_runtime -> xdr_incident_fabric -> xdr_evidence_flow -> forensic ring + ids_evidence_receipt; no provider or enforcement ABI

layers.name: Detection Identity Gate
layers.note: The feed runs only when detection_rule_id != 0 and the event source maps to an XDR category; plain packets never enter.

layers.name: Advisory Observation Handoff
layers.input: Source category, entity key, severity, source event
layers.output: ObserveOutcome with incident id and optional frozen batch
layers.note: ObserveOutcome is reset before every observation so stale rows cannot be mistaken for a new freeze. Refusals are fail-soft and counted; this adapter computes no score and requests no action.

layers.name: Multi-source Advisory Freeze
layers.note: An assessment freezes only when at least two distinct source categories are present; the Decision has no action field.

layers.name: Forensic Snapshot Append
layers.output: Accepted forensic sequence and versioned XDR snapshot
layers.note: The bridge rejects zero source ids, non-multi-source batches, multi-entity evidence, and source events absent from the batch.

layers.name: Hash Read-back and IDS Evidence Receipt
layers.input: Accepted snapshot sequence + authenticated record hash
layers.output: Recording-only IDS Evidence Receipt bound to the record
layers.note: A receipt is issued only after append and recordHash read-back. It is a non-enforcement IDS receipt and contains no provider, filter, or host-action field.

layers.name: Replay Verification
layers.note: Replay compares the frozen advisory assessment deterministically; it does not re-run policy, PEP, or any host effect.

layers.name: Advisory Read View and Receipt Counters
layers.input: Recorded receipt counters and in-memory incidents
layers.note: xdr.list is the sole consumer and is read-role/non-mutating. It exposes receipts_recorded, receipts_failed, and receipts_skipped; no consumer may branch policy or host effects on this view.

layers.name: Recording-only Boundary
layers.note: The receipt value is discarded by the caller. No policy, PEP, DEFCON, ActionDispatcher, or host-effect path consumes XDR output; Windows E5 host proof of this route remains OPEN.

flows.name: Minifilter kernel rows -> EventQueue -> data-integrity health
flows.description: Kernel minifilter file/process records are pulled by the Zig reader and admitted to the shared EventQueue. Kernel-ring overflow and queue rejection are separate counters; any observed ingress loss makes health DEGRADED. This path records evidence only and cannot authorize policy or host effects.
flows.boundary: Filter Manager communication port -> Zig minifilter reader -> shared EventQueue -> queue.stats / health

layers.name: Kernel event collection
layers.output: Records in the kernel ring; ring overflow counter

layers.name: Ring read and canonical conversion
layers.output: Canonical host events submitted to EventQueue

layers.name: Queue admission and loss accounting
layers.output: Queued events or separately counted pipeline rejections

layers.name: Operational health and operator visibility
layers.input: Queue, Nose, and minifilter loss counters
layers.output: DEGRADED health and labeled integrity counters
layers.note: Cumulative loss counters remain visible for the daemon lifetime; no automatic enforcement or service stop.
